name: Grand Hotel Bucharest (former InterContinental)
elevationDatum: Rigid local foundation y=0; real metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Two mapped controls fix rotation, baked into the geometry once. No terrain or Mercator stretch.
note: Grand Hotel Bucharest, the former InterContinental: three concave balcony facades around a Y-shaped tower, tall pale end piers, a broad podium and curved roof crown. Published roof height is 87 m; OSM tower part is tagged 90 m. The model uses 87 m for the roof and an estimated 3 m antenna for a 90 m overall height. Balcony spacing, inset depth, podium divisions and roof crown are estimates. The current Grand Hotel name is recorded; all old/new logos and lettering are omitted. Cityscape: not tested; Full 3D world: not tested. Review follow-up: Far LOD groups the tower into 14 discrete balcony/window levels instead of 20 near levels, reducing far cost to 5923 triangles. The three concave frontage groups, inset glazing, balcony plates, tall end piers and dipped crown remain; the new sheet retains the curved balcony rhythm. Near geometry is unchanged.
